breakdown.description: The prompt forms the strain energy with a constant peak moment, even though the cantilever bending moment under an end load varies along the span.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the varying bending moment M(x) = P(L-x) instead of the constant peak value M = PL. This directly fixes the inconsistency where the incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed using a constant peak moment over the full span. The generated specification aligns with the ground truth by using the proper position-dependent moment expression.
